preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(s, str) for s in arr)
preconditions.description: All elements in arr must be strings.
The input array arr must not be empty.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 30 for s in arr)
preconditions.description: Each string in arr must have length between 1 and 30 (inclusive).

postconditions.expression: return_value == '' or (all(s in arr for s in [return_value[i:j] for i in range(len(return_value) + 1) for j in range(i + 1, len(return_value) + 1)]))
postconditions.description: If return_value is non-empty, all prefixes of return_value must exist in arr.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '' or (all(len(s) <= len(return_value) for s in arr if all(s2 in arr for s2 in [s[i:j] for i in range(len(s) + 1) for j in range(i + 1, len(s) + 1)])))
postconditions.description: If return_value is non-empty, it must be the longest string in arr where all its prefixes exist in arr.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '' or (all(return_value <= s for s in arr if len(s) == len(return_value) and all(s2 in arr for s2 in [s[i:j] for i in range(len(s) + 1) for j in range(i + 1, len(s) + 1)])))
postconditions.description: If return_value is non-empty and there are multiple strings of the same maximum length satisfying Q2, return_value must be the lexicographically smallest one.
If return_value is non-empty, it must be one of the strings in arr.
